material_findings: A third consecutive autonomous SUB opportunity emitted NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET after a fresh R26/Main/source reconciliation, created no candidate, research branch, workflow, identity or scientific observation, and stayed outside MECHANISM and conversion denominators.
The scientific-selection window remains MECHANISM/SYSTEM/SYSTEM=1/3 while no-target checks increased to three; the ratio alone cannot characterize ongoing mechanism-supply health.

The third event remains credible because it records the fresh canonical closure of the prior SYSTEM object, separately reconsiders H7, terminal/exactly-reduced families and source-transparent surfaces, and does not silently copy the prior exception.

Repeated no-target checks under essentially the same mechanism-relevant landscape should not be narrated as independent confirmations of methodology calibration; they constitute a persistent supply-stall episode unless a material mechanism-surface delta occurs.
Fresh MAIN consumed Analyst R27 and remained intentionally scientifically idle rather than manufacture a candidate or reopen terminal work.
false_positive_risks: The frozen 1/3 actual-selection ratio can look healthy while no-target checks accumulate; current separate event counting mitigates this but episode independence is not explicit.
Repeated scheduler opportunities under the same mechanism landscape can be over-read as independent evidence that NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET is increasingly validated.
Repeated NO_COHERENT_MECHANISM_TARGET use could become an escape hatch if a future mechanism-surface delta creates a coherent target and that surface is not explicitly reconsidered.
A future SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM run could be post-hoc justified unless the machine-readable exception is persisted before execution.
External-validation effects can be overinterpreted when a reference is degenerate or relevant simple reductions/source clustering are omitted.
false_negative_risks: Repeated no-op can become discovery inertia if unchanged source/code is treated as sufficient reason not to perform genuine theory-backward reframing; source delta is not a prerequisite for a new theory-level question.
Do not force a MECHANISM object merely to move the rolling share above 1/3; a well-justified no-target no-op remains preferable to manufactured or duplicative work.
Do not turn three no-target checks into a universal numeric exception-rate cutoff; the appropriate response is qualitative episode-aware reframe/observability, not a hard threshold.
Do not suppress bounded SYSTEM architecture/reproducibility work when no comparable executable/informative MECHANISM exists.
Do not require positive signal or prior comparator/reduction victory merely to become preformal_eligible or READY.
